items.title: Gingerbread Hedgehog with an Apple
items.alt: Side-view hedgehog-shaped gingerbread cookie with chocolate icing spines, a cream muzzle and a small red apple by its nose.
items.description: White strokes accent the pointed chocolate spines above two tiny rounded cookie feet.

items.title: Gingerbread Reindeer Face Cookie
items.alt: Reindeer-head gingerbread cookie with two branched antlers, almond icing eyes and a green bow below its chin.
items.description: White icing follows the antlers and ears around a central diamond forehead marking and a round brown nose.

items.title: Dancing Gingerbread Mittens
items.alt: Two smiling mitten-shaped gingerbread characters joined by a red cord, one with a star decoration and the other with green chevron icing.
items.description: Their small cookie feet and different expressions turn the mismatched mittens into a playful pair.

items.title: Iced Gingerbread Snowflake Cookie
items.alt: Six-armed gingerbread snowflake cookie decorated with white lace-like icing and a round blue candy center.
items.description: Piped branches and pearl-shaped icing dots follow each amber cookie arm around the symmetrical center.

items.title: Gingerbread Christmas Tree Cookie
items.alt: Fir-tree gingerbread cookie with green zigzag icing garlands, red candy berries and a gold star at its tip.
items.description: The irregular stacked branches narrow toward the star above a short exposed brown cookie trunk.

items.title: Gingerbread Bell with a Red Bow
items.alt: Bell-shaped gingerbread cookie with white icing filigree, a broad red bow and holly above a red candy clapper.
items.description: Gold candy dots and a curved white border emphasize the flared bell body and its shaded opening.
